summary.note: Every remaining partial clause is an evidence gate (exact consumer, player build, upgrade/rollback, API review, and named-device receipts) that no package test can close. Entries prefixed validator: are repository validation rules, not Unity tests; the Unity tests named here have not executed in an Editor since the audited commit. Each of the ten Inventory test assemblies outside Core (whose assembly is mapped in coverage-map.core.json) has exactly one gate here, and every attributed test method of those assemblies is listed in exactly one gate.
